mathematics.assertion_tested: Verify force versus potential, Eddington versus Jeans velocity moment, common-seed timestep convergence, independent-seed consistency, matched no-kick controls, and Poisson sampling in the persisted finite runs.
mathematics.conventions: Checks certify only implementation consistency and finite numerical findings in a prescribed fixed NFW potential.
inputs: audit_orbits.py and two persisted results files in the same orbits directory
non_claims: Does not prove a MOND action, realistic clock coupling, self-consistent halo response, or universal exclusion of C003.
Scientific gate failures are separated from numerical check failures.
